justification: Inspected `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/toplist/AbstractTopListVisitable.java` (81 lines) plus `AbstractCompilationVisitable.java`, `TreeVisitor.java`, and the subclasses `CompileTimeTopListVisitable.java`, `InliningFailReasonTopListVisitable.java`, and `StaleTaskToplistVisitable.java`. The target class is a thin abstract template: it only stores shared state (`model`, `topList`, `sortHighToLow`), provides one concrete orchestration method (`buildTopList`), and exposes empty hooks (`reset`, `postProcess`, `visitTag`) for subclasses. The actual per-smell responsibilities are split into focused subclasses, and tree traversal is already separated in `TreeVisitor.walkTree`, so the class does not show excessive responsibilities or lack of decomposition.
